subject: ACL drift audit + VPC/on-prem network readiness for go-live
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: ops@acme-logistics.com, netops-lead@globex.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACL drift audit kickoff + dates for edge readiness

Hi team,

I want to get ahead of any ACL/route drift before our scheduled private deployment activation window on July 8. Attached is a current ACL export from our staging fabric (20270702-acme-acl-export.csv). Can your network teams confirm the following by EOD Monday (July 5):

- A short diffs report: any ACL/rule present in prod that is not in the export or vice versa
- Confirmation of SNAT/DNAT mappings for the control plane endpoints
- Any expected late firewall changes from the cloud provider or colo that could affect the management plane

Operational asks:
- Laura: can you lead an automated sweep to validate neighbor adjacencies and BGP session counts after the ACL pass?
- Marissa: please prepare a trimmed runbook snippet that contains the fallback ACL lines and an explicit rollback trigger (we want a single bullet "rollback now" with what to revert).

External teams, please reply with a short matrix (pass/warn/fail) and any required change windows. If you need a 30-minute bridge next week, call it out here and we'll schedule.

Thanks,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Netops Lead <netops-lead@globex.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ops@acme-logistics.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACL drift audit kickoff + dates for edge readiness

Aditya / Laura,

Quick update from Globex network team after running the export against our live configs: attached is a compact sheet of diffs (we trimmed some noise). Highlights:

- Minor ordering differences in ACL IDs 4001-4006 (no functional change)
- Two missing allow rules for tcp/2202 toward control-plane-02 (recommend add)
- No DNAT changes expected; SNAT is in place for outbound telemetry to telemetry.redwood.svc

We can push the two allow rules during a 15-minute window on Wed July 7, 02:00-02:30 UTC. That should not affect production traffic; we recommend keeping the window pinned as a contingency step before cutover.

Attached: acl-diffs-compact.csv

- Sam (NetOps)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, netops-lead@globex.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 02:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACL drift audit kickoff + dates for edge readiness

Sam / team,

Thanks for the diff. I kicked off the automated adjacency sweep (script: nw-adj-sweep v1.4) against the nodes in the export; summary below:

- BGP sessions: all expected sessions (24/24) present, no flaps in the last 48h
- Adj latency: two peerings showed 12ms/14ms vs expected <10ms; both are in the same colo rack and likely micro-congestion during sampling
- Control-plane reachability: all control-plane IPs reachable from our staging probes

Action items I opened:
1) Sam to schedule the two-rule push in the 02:00 UTC window.
2) Marissa, can you add an explicit "start latency sampling" step to the runbook (we want a quick 10-sample histogram pre/post-change)?

I'll attach the raw sweep log to the shared drive.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Network Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acme-logistics.com, solutions@edge-integrations.io
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACL drift audit kickoff + dates for edge readiness

Team,

I updated the runbook (runbook-v2.1.pdf) with a small "safety audit" section and a compact rollback snippet. Key additions:

- Pre-change checklist: sample clients, telemetry endpoints, and KV cache warmup checklist
- Latency sampling procedure: 10-sample histogram, store CSV as latency-sample-07-05.csv, include comparison threshold 95th < 40ms
- Rollback: single-step ACL revert + incremented monitor period (10m) before continuing

I'll be on the bridge for the July 7 window and will run the sampling live. If the sample shows >50ms 95th we hit rollback.

Attachment: runbook-v2.1.pdf

Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@acme-logistics.com, netops-lead@globex.com, solutions@edge-integrations.io
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACL drift audit kickoff + dates for edge readiness — final confirmation and bridge plan

All,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Final notes before we close the audit:

1) Sam confirmed the 02:00 UTC small-rule push on July 7; that will be our pre-cutover contingency change.
2) Marissa's sampling threshold and rollback criteria look good; please ensure the latency CSV is uploaded to the drive within 15 minutes of the tests.
3) Priyom: please ensure the control-plane certificate rotation job is disabled for the July 8 activation window (we've had noisy reloads during previous activations).

Bridge plan (Jul 8 activation):
- 17:45 UTC: ops and netops join bridge (15m pre-check)
- 18:00 UTC: open activation window, start KV warmups and prefix cache priming
- 18:10 UTC: lightweight traffic smoke (1% of baseline traffic) with latency sampling
- 18:20 UTC: if smoke passes, scale to full traffic; else execute rollback ACL revert and monitor 10m

Please reply with a single-line ack or call out any remaining blockers. If none, I'll publish this as the activation appendix and circulate to the customer.

--
Aditya
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
